17 open-source Philips Hue projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Philips Hue lights and bridges. 6 of 17 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: phue, ha-bridge, diyHue, Hue-Emulator, huesyncbox.
